name: mapping-co-scientist
description: Claude Code plugin for ontology alignment and schema field mapping with three-agent debate review.
author: Neuronautix

commands.name: ontology-align
commands.description: Run ontology alignment pipeline and guide semantic mapping review via three-agent debate

commands.name: schema-align
commands.description: Run schema alignment pipeline and guide field mapping review via three-agent debate

commands.name: review-mappings
commands.description: Review existing pipeline output using the three-agent debate protocol

commands.name: validate-and-export
commands.description: Run pre-export checks and generate final mapping artefacts

agents.name: source-schema-advocate
agents.role: Advocates for the source schema; argues FROM the source side whether proposed mappings correctly characterise source field meaning

agents.name: target-schema-advocate
agents.role: Advocates for the target schema/ontology; argues FROM the target side whether proposed predicates/operations are semantically appropriate

agents.name: mapping-mediator
agents.role: Runs the Structured Evidence Debate protocol; applies LR scoring formula; produces ranked candidates and cross-mapping consistency report
